mapper.select: SELECT MONTH(IFNULL(confirm_time, receive_time)) AS m, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_receipt WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 2 AND YEAR(IFNULL(confirm_time, receive_time)) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(IFNULL(confirm_time, receive_time))
SELECT MONTH(create_time) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crm_customer WHERE deleted = 0 AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(create_time)

SELECT MONTH(submit_time) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(payable_amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (4, 5) AND YEAR(submit_time) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(submit_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submit_time, '%Y-%m') AS ym, IFNULL(service_type, '未分类') AS service_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(payable_amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (4, 5) AND YEAR(submit_time) = #{year} AND (#{month} IS NULL OR MONTH(submit_time) = #{month}) GROUP BY ym, service_type ORDER BY ym

SELECT MONTH(create_time) AS m, renewal_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM biz_renewal_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'confirmed' AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(create_time), renewal_type

SELECT receivable_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable, IFNULL(SUM(arrears_amount), 0) AS arrears FROM fin_receivable_renewal WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY receivable_status ORDER BY receivable_status

SELECT receivable_month AS ym, IFNULL(SUM(receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable, IFNULL(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS received, IFNULL(SUM(arrears_amount), 0) AS arrears FROM fin_receivable_renewal WHERE deleted = 0 AND receivable_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '-%') GROUP BY receivable_month ORDER BY receivable_month

SELECT c.id, c.customer_name, c.contract_no, c.end_date, c.amount FROM biz_contract c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 4 AND c.end_date >= CURDATE() AND c.end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_contract r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 4 AND r.parent_id = c.id ) ORDER BY c.end_date LIMIT 200

SELECT CASE WHEN t.total >= 100000 THEN 'A' WHEN t.total >= 50000 THEN 'B' WHEN t.total >= 10000 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS band, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(t.total), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT customer_id, SUM(payable_amount) AS total FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (4, 5) AND customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id ) t GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS lead_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted FROM crm_lead WHERE deleted = 0 AND (#{start} IS NULL OR create_time >= #{start}) AND (#{end} IS NULL OR create_time <= CONCAT(#{end}, ' 23:59:59')) GROUP BY source ORDER BY lead_cnt DESC

SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt FROM crm_customer WHERE deleted = 0 AND (#{start} IS NULL OR create_time >= #{start}) AND (#{end} IS NULL OR create_time <= CONCAT(#{end}, ' 23:59:59')) GROUP BY source ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crm_lead WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT MONTH(create_time) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crm_follow WHERE deleted = 0 AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(create_time)

SELECT MONTH(call_time) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN connected = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS connected FROM biz_call_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND call_time IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(call_time) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(call_time)

SELECT c.agent_id AS user_id, MAX(c.agent_name) AS agent_name, COUNT(*) AS call_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.connected = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS connected FROM biz_call_record c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND c.call_time IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(c.call_time) = #{year} GROUP BY c.agent_id ORDER BY call_cnt DESC LIMIT 30
